question.prompt:
What is the area of the shaded figure shown below?

[Figure 1](figures/2021_Fall_AMC_12B_Q02_question_fig1.svg)

solutions.explanation:
The shaded region is the triangle with vertices \((1,0),(3,5),(5,0)\) after removing the inner triangle with vertices \((1,0),(3,2),(5,0)\). Both triangles have the same horizontal base of length \(5-1=4\). Their heights above that base are \(5\) and \(2\), respectively. Therefore the shaded area is
\[
\frac12\cdot4\cdot5-\frac12\cdot4\cdot2
=10-4=\boxed{6}
\]
square units, choice \(\mathrm{B}\).
solutions.title: Subtract the inner triangle
